+async def pending_navigation_fallback_lease_observation() -> (
+    PendingNavigationLeaseObservation
+):
+    page = _application_page()
+    harness = await interactive_service_harness(
+        InteractiveHarnessOptions(active=True, viewer_page=page)
+    )
+    run_id = harness.lease_request.run_id
+    snapshot = await harness.host.registry.get_session(harness.invocation.access)
+    signature = await navigation_step_signature(
+        page, phase=NavigationPhase.APPLICATION_ENTRY
+    )
+    page.evaluate.return_value = {
+        "url": _APPLICATION_PAGE_URL,
+        "heading": "Changed application",
+        "controls": 1,
+        "activeSteps": "",
+        "bodyStep": "",
+    }
+    context = NavigationInterruptContext(
+        run_id=run_id,
+        thread_id=f"thread-{run_id}",
+        phase="application_entry",
+        stage="application_gate",
+        reason="ambiguous",
+        checkpoint="human_review",
+        generation=int(snapshot.generation),
+        page_signature=signature,
+        takeover_available=True,
+    )
+    harness.manager.interrupt_records[run_id].clear()
+    harness.manager.register_run(run_id, f"thread-{run_id}")
+    harness.manager.request_interrupt(
+        run_id,
+        "navigation:application_entry:ambiguous",
+        "navigation pause",
+        context.to_json(),
+    )
+
+    grant = await harness.service.create_interactive_lease(
+        harness.lease_request.model_copy(
+            update={"checkpoint": "human_review", "generation": snapshot.generation}
+        ),
+        process_owner=OWNER,
+    )
+    retained = harness.host.retained_sessions[harness.invocation.access.run_id]
+    return PendingNavigationLeaseObservation(
+        grant_checkpoint=grant.session.checkpoint,
+        takeover_reservations=len(retained.takeover_reservations),
+    )
